## Objective
Use benchmark val_score as the search and winner criterion.
Do not use held-out test metrics during search.
Thompson Sampling chooses arms; this skill only guides how to edit code within selected arms.

## Recent Patch Lessons
- Round 6 provisional jump entered a new basin using combination_jump/combination_jump ↑. Do not treat it as a winner until retune beats the saved incumbent validation score.
- Round 7 winner changed validation score by -0.0050 using interest_aggregation/interest_aggregation ↓. Val score also improved — high confidence direction.
